kpte08.title: Scorpio, say the soft thing
kpte08.caption: Typed 'I like you', deleted it, sent 'lol'? Walls keep out the right people too. Soft isn't weak, it's brave. Say it once, plainly.

kpte09.title: Sagittarius, unpack the suitcase
kpte09.caption: Liking someone and wanting to run at the same time is so human. Liking someone isn't a cage. Tell them you're a little scared; honesty makes room to stay.

kpte10.title: Capricorn, close the laptop
kpte10.caption: Cancelling plans for 'one more email' again? Rest isn't a prize you have to earn, and you're wanted, not just useful. Say yes to one slow evening this week.

kpte11.title: Aquarius, your weird is the point
kpte11.caption: Ever felt like nobody gets you? Don't sand yourself down to fit a room. Your people are out there being weird too, so go where your weird is welcome.

kpte12.title: Pisces, keep some for you
kpte12.caption: For the friend who gives everyone everything: your big heart isn't the problem. It just lives in you too. Keep one piece for yourself tonight.

kpte13.title: Taurus, you are not behind
kpte13.caption: Everyone's getting engaged and you feel late? There's no deadline on love, and their timeline isn't your scoreboard. Build a life you love in the meantime.

kpte14.title: Virgo, take your own advice
kpte14.caption: You'd never let your best friend settle, so don't let yourself. Talk to you the way you talk to them. Tag the friend who gives advice and never takes it.

kpte15.title: Gemini, you deserve a definitely
kpte15.caption: Stuck on 'we'll see'? That isn't an answer. Ask once, clearly, then believe what they tell you. You're allowed to want something sure.
